text:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — planning cutover for dedicated capacity autoscale policy tomorrow 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. Minimal traffic window. Who's available to run/observe?

Kevin: I can drive the rollout. Will be on call from 01:30 UTC.

Sam: I’ll own smoke tests + perf checks. List the exact checkpoints and scripts pls.

Nisha: I’ll be standby for rollback and capacity sanity.

Ashley: Thanks. Kevin — plan is: lock pool, apply new autoscale policy (lower burst threshold, stricter cooldown), prime reserved nodes, run smoke, then enable global routing. If anything >=5% latency increase or error spike, rollback.

Kevin: Deployment steps I’ll follow:
1) `poolctl lock --pool gpu-dedicated-prod`
2) `apply-policy --file policies/autoscale-q2.json --pool gpu-dedicated-prod`
3) wait for nodes to reach Ready (watch `kubectl get pods -l pool=gpu-dedicated`)
4) `./tools/prime-nodes --pool gpu-dedicated-prod --model gptx-7b`
5) smoke: `./smoke/run_smoke.sh --endpoint /v1/generate --concurrency 5`
6) flip traffic: `routerctl set-route --pool gpu-dedicated-prod --weight 100`

Sam: Smoke script outputs: success if p50 latency < 90ms and error rate < 0.5%. I’ll post a short report to thread.

Deploy-bot: scheduled job 1763508005 created by kevin for 2026-04-12T02:00:05Z — CI checks passed.

Kevin: I'll tag @platform-oncall when starting. Rollback plan: revert policy with `apply-policy --file policies/autoscale-q2-rollback.json`, re-open pool if locked, and route back to fallback pool `gpu-shared-fallback`. Terraform state snapshot: s3://redwood-backups/terraform/1763507890-tfstate.

Nisha: Confirmed I have admin creds and tested rollback commands in staging.

Ashley: Timing check — please be in this thread 01:45 UTC for final go/no-go. If you can’t make it, call me. :thumbsup:

Sam: Got it, will post smoke summary within 10m after smoke run.

Kevin: Will start the run at 02:00:05 UTC — I’ll update thread at each step.

Ashley: Thanks team, appreciate the quick sync.

Sam: Quick note — monitor token-generation throughput and KV cache hit rate (infra dashboard -> gpu-dedicated-prod).

Kevin: Noted. If anything odd, I’ll open an incident channel and pin steps.

Nisha: I’ll be watching GC and node OOM signals.

Ashley: Excellent. See you tomorrow. :rocket:
